text:
maria.eng: Heads up — Acme is asking for a single ingestion contract doc that covers webhook + S3 export + Splunk/Datadog formats, plus KMS envelope details. Do we have a canonical checklist or do we need to stitch components?

oliver.sec: We have fragments across the wiki. Important callouts: schema changes (we're proposing v2 with tenant_id and resource.path[]), RBAC updates (new `audit-reader` role mapping), and explicit KMS BYOK vs RW-managed options. Need one place that ties them together.

sam.platform: For webhook delivery: signature header `X-RW-Signature` (HMAC-SHA256 over `<timestamp>\n<body>`), include `X-RW-Timestamp`. If we return 5xx they should retry. We also support `Idempotency-Key` header to dedupe. Sample headers: `X-RW-Timestamp: 1678900000`, `X-RW-Signature: sha256=...`, `Idempotency-Key: acme-export-20260318-01`.

jenna-ps: On Splunk / Datadog: Splunk HEC expects a flat `_json` field or raw JSON per event; Datadog wants `ddsource`/`service` tags. We'll publish two adapter examples (splunk_hec_adapter.py, datadog_adapter.json).

kevin-sre: S3 exports are newline-delimited JSON, gzipped, partitioned by tenant/date: `s3://redwood-audit-exports/<tenant>/<YYYY>/<MM>/<DD>/export-<ts>.json.gz`. Each file encrypted with envelope key. We add `x-amz-meta-kms-key-id` and `x-amz-meta-export-id` metadata. Customer SIEMs sometimes choke on compression; we should verify they can consume gzipped ndjson or provide uncompressed option.

luis-crypto: KMS: we support two modes: (1) Customer-managed KMS (BYOK) — we store the wrapped data key, include `kms_context` = `{tenant_id, export_id}`, and we publish the encrypted DEK in S3 metadata; (2) Redwood-managed KMS with customer key alias mapping. Rotation: rotate DEK per-file and rewrap with new KEK quarterly. Document recovery/rotation procedure.

maria.eng: Schema compatibility question: if we add `resource.path` as an array, will older parsers break? Many SIEM mappings expect `resource.path` as string.

oliver.sec: We must follow additive-only changes for a minor bump. Add `schema_version` top-level. Old parsers should ignore unknown fields; we should include a `schema_transforms` guide for customers that need flattened fields. Also publish a deprecation schedule for any rename.

audit-bot: AUTOMATED: schema-validator run at 2123456790 — payload passed with warnings: unknown_field `user.phone`.

sam.platform: I'll draft the contract. Contract should include: 1) sample webhook payload + signature verification, 2) S3 file naming + metadata + KMS envelope spec, 3) Splunk/Datadog mapping examples, 4) retry semantics and idempotency, 5) RBAC roles and ACLs for `audit-reader` and `audit-admin`, 6) validation SLA (we'll validate sample payloads within 24h).

jenna-ps: Add examples for Splunk HEC ingestion (`_json`) and for Datadog logs (attributes `ddsource`, `service`). Also include mapping notes for SIEM parsers: flatten `resource.path` -> `resource_path` for older systems.

luis-crypto: Add recommended KMS policy snippet to the contract. Example: `{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:ReEncrypt*","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/<customer-key>"}]}`. Also mention `kms:EncryptionContext` usage.

kevin-sre: I'll validate S3 export delivery to Acme's test bucket tomorrow. Need sample export file and a few rotated keys to test key rewrap.

maria.eng: Quick sample webhook payload for the contract (include as-is):
```json
{
  "schema_version": "v2",
  "event_type": "model.update",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T15:02:30Z",
  "tenant_id": "acme-corp",
  "resource": {"id": "model-123", "path": ["projects","prod","models","gpt"], "type": "model"},
  "actor": {"id": "service/redwood", "role": "system"},
  "meta": {"trace_id": "aaaa-1111"},
  "changes": {"from": "v1", "to": "v2"}
}
```

sam.platform: Good. Also include an envelope signature example in the doc: `X-RW-Signature: sha256=<hex>`, verify as `HMAC_SHA256(timestamp + '.' + body, shared_secret)` and reject if `abs(now - timestamp) > 5min`.

oliver.sec: RBAC: propose `audit-reader` (view-only exports + read S3 listings with bucket policy), `audit-ingest-admin` (can configure delivery endpoints), `audit-admin` (full). Make sure to call out least privilege and separation for KMS rewrap permissions.

maria.eng: Action items: sam.platform to draft the contract and sample artifacts, oliver.sec to review security/KMS language, luis-crypto to pen rotation/recovery steps, kevin-sre to run S3 delivery test, jenna-ps to provide Splunk/Datadog adapters. Target: EOD +3 for a first draft. :calendar:

jenna-ps: ACK. I'll attach adapter stubs in the contract PR. :thumbsup:

oliver.sec: If we can get Acme's legal to sign the ingestion contract (BYOK vs RW KMS) that's the gating item. Otherwise we'll provide a RW-managed fallback.

maria.eng: Thanks everyone — I'll open the contract PR and tag assignees.

kevin-sre: Small note: add a health-check endpoint for webhook handshake that returns `200` + `validation_status` so customers can confirm delivery path during integration.

maria.eng: Great call — include `GET /audit-ingest/handshake?export_id=<id>` returning `{"status":"ok","validation_status":"pass"}`.

oliver.sec: Closing loop: ensure we log audit of the onboarding process itself (who approved BYOK, contract sign-off). That's meta-audit we need to surface.

maria.eng: Noted. I'll add it to the checklist.
